title: Meta's Oversight Board says Meta agreed to increase its funding by $13M, ensuring that it will be funded through 2028, reversing a planned decrease in funding (Casey Newton/Platformer)
summary: Casey Newton / Platformer: Meta's Oversight Board says Meta agreed to increase its funding by $13M, ensuring that it will be funded through 2028, reversing a planned decrease in funding — Meta has agreed to increase funding to its external Oversight Board by $13 million, Platformer has learned …
